ST. LOUIS, Mo., October 01, 2026--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Belden Inc. (NYSE: BDC), a leading global provider of complete connection solutions, today announced the new Belden and Edge2Web Smart Factory Insights solution, powered by AWS IoT SiteWise. The solution helps manufacturers drive continuous improvement across the plant floor by digitizing operations and visualizing key performance indicators (KPIs).
Manufacturers are under pressure to improve efficiency, but turning plant floor data into action remains difficult. Many operations still run on a patchwork of control systems and manual processes that make real-time performance visibility hard to achieve.
The solution delivers:
No-code tools to create custom KPIs, dashboards and scorecards without programming
Multi-protocol support connecting more than 300 industrial protocols and device types
GenAI-powered summaries, alerts and digital playbooks for faster decision-making
Scalability from single-site deployments to global, multi-site operations

They are missing the connection from data to decisions, and getting there usually means stitching together three or four vendors and hoping it holds together. "Manufacturing leaders need end-to-end solutions that enable reduced downtime, improved product quality, and optimized energy utilization. By combining best-in-class edge data acquisition with advanced performance analytics and AI, Belden and Edge2Web are partnering to address complex manufacturing challenges quickly and at scale," said Fred Holahan, Co-Founder and CEO, Edge2Web, Inc.

ST. LOUIS, September 24, 2026--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Belden Inc. (NYSE: BDC), a leading global provider of complete connection solutions, announces today that it will manufacture select RUCKUS Networks ICX Ethernet switches at its Pune, India facility. This signals an important step in the integration of RUCKUS, a Belden brand, into Belden through early initiatives focused on leveraging the combined company's manufacturing, supply chain, commercial and operational capabilities to create value and accelerate growth.
The initiative extends RUCKUS' significant existing presence in India into manufacturing while demonstrating how Belden can use its global operating footprint to support the RUCKUS portfolio and expand opportunities in key markets. The result is a more scalable local model that will better serve customers and partners.
"From the outset, our focus has been on bringing Belden and RUCKUS together in ways that create meaningful value for our customers and shareholders," said Dr. Ashish Chand, President and CEO of Belden. Manufacturing the RUCKUS ICX Ethernet in India is an early example of that strategy in action, and we see additional opportunities to apply this approach as the integration progresses."
Belden's global manufacturing and operational footprint provides opportunities to integrate RUCKUS capabilities into existing infrastructure rather duplicating efforts. India provides an early example of this approach.
